name: UserTourKit
tagline: What it is User Tour Kit is a headless onboarding and product-tour library for React
description: What it is User Tour Kit is a headless onboarding and product-tour library for React. You get the logic — state, positioning, focus management, persistence — and keep full control of the markup, so every tour, hint, and checklist matches your design system instead of fighting it.
